\section{Overview}
\subsection*{Brief: esp32c3-node (unattended track run, 2026-10-01)}
A tiny WiFi + Bluetooth LE sensor node, in the spirit of the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3. Product scope (no mode token), 2 layers, meant to go to JLCPCB as-is with economy PCBA.

\begin{itemize}
\item ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module; keep its antenna keep-out clear of copper and parts, antenna at a board edge.
\item USB-C for power and flashing over the C3's native USB (no USB-UART bridge); BOOT and RESET buttons.
\item Runs from a single-cell LiPo (JST-PH 2-pin) with a charger that has power path, so it runs
from USB with or without a battery. 3.3 V LDO for everything. Battery voltage sense into an ADC pin.
\item A BME280-class temperature/humidity/pressure sensor on I2C, plus a Qwiic/STEMMA QT connector on the same bus.
\item One status LED on a GPIO.
\item Keep it small, roughly XIAO-sized if an honest layout allows; spare GPIOs on castellated or 0.1 in edge pads.
\end{itemize}
\section{Requirements}
\subsection*{requirements - esp32c3-node}
P0 requirements distilled from \texttt{brief/brief.md} (2026-10-01, unattended track run). One agent played the P0-P3 roles in sequence (spend cap); see state.json decisions.

\subsubsection*{1. Function}
Mode declaration: the brief carries NO mode token, so mode = none - design normally. Scope = product, per the brief's own words ("product scope ... meant to go to JLCPCB as-is"): protection, filtering and enclosure-free robustness are in scope and their absence is a reviewer finding. Binding: the "roughly XIAO-sized" size is a SOFT preference (no HARD cap, section 5). Stage under study: none.

A tiny 2-layer WiFi + Bluetooth LE sensor node built around an Espressif ESP32-C3-MINI-1 module (PCB antenna). USB-C supplies 5 V and carries the C3's native USB (USB-Serial-JTAG on GPIO18/GPIO19) for flashing and console - no USB-UART bridge. A single-cell LiPo on a JST-PH 2-pin connector is charged from USB by a charger with power path, so the board runs from USB with or without a battery and from the battery alone. One 3.3 V LDO feeds everything. The battery voltage is divided down into an ADC pin. A BME280-class T/RH/P sensor and a Qwiic/STEMMA QT connector share one I2C bus. BOOT and RESET buttons, one status LED, spare GPIOs on 0.1 in edge pads. Quantity 5, JLC economy PCBA.

\subsubsection*{2. Interfaces}
\begin{itemize}
\item USB-C receptacle, USB 2.0 full-speed device (12 Mb/s), D+/D- to the module's
GPIO19/GPIO18 (USB\_D+/USB\_D-), ESD protection on D+/D-/VBUS, 5.1 k Rd on CC1
and CC2 independently (default-USB sink, \textless{}= 500 mA).
\item Battery: JST-PH 2.0 mm 2-pin, 1S LiPo (see section 3 and section 8).
\item Qwiic / STEMMA QT: JST-SH 1.0 mm 4-pin, GND / 3V3 / SDA / SCL (Qwiic order),
same I2C bus as the sensor, on-board pull-ups.
\item BOOT button on GPIO9 (low at reset = download mode); RESET button on EN with
the RC delay the module datasheet requires.
\item Status LED on a GPIO that is not a boot-breaking strap pin.
\item Spare GPIOs on 0.1 in (2.54 mm) plated edge pads. ASSUMED: plain plated
through-holes at the board edge, not castellations (castellation is a paid
JLC option; see open question 6).
\item Antenna: the module's PCB antenna at a board edge with the datasheet keep-out
free of copper (all layers) and parts.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{3. Power}
\begin{itemize}
\item Input 1: USB-C VBUS 5 V nominal (4.75-5.25 V), default-USB current
(\textless{}= 500 mA) - no PD.
\item Input 2: 1S LiPo, 3.0-4.2 V (3.7 V nominal). PROVISIONAL (section 8): cell
class \textasciitilde{}400 mAh with its own protection PCB; charge to 4.20 V.
\item Charger with power path: system load is served from VBUS when present, the
battery charges with what is left; without VBUS the system runs from the
battery. Charge current PROVISIONAL \textless{}= 200 mA (0.5C of a 400 mAh cell).
\item 3.3 V rail: one LDO, \textgreater{}= 500 mA, low dropout (runs from the battery down to
\textasciitilde{}3.5 V cell), low Iq for battery life.
\item Battery sense: divider from VBAT into an ADC1 pin (ESP32-C3 ADC1, GPIO0-4).
\item Rail budget (GUESSES, architect replaces them): ESP32-C3 WiFi TX peaks
\textasciitilde{}350 mA (module datasheet), BME280 \textless{} 1 mA, LED \textasciitilde{}2 mA, Qwiic reserve 100 mA
(open question 3). Peak 3V3 \textasciitilde{} 450 mA.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{4. Environment}
Not stated. ASSUMED: indoor, 0-40 C ambient, bare board, no ingress or vibration requirement (open question 2). LiPo charging allowed only 0-45 C; without an NTC the board relies on the cell's protection PCB and the charger's die-temperature regulation (section 8).

\subsubsection*{5. Size \& mounting}
\begin{itemize}
\item Outline: "roughly XIAO-sized (21 x 17.8 mm) if an honest layout allows" -
a SOFT preference, no HARD cap. The module alone is 13.2 x 16.6 mm and the
antenna keep-out must sit at an edge, so the layout earns the outline at
P5/P6 (open question 5).
\item Mounting holes: none stated. ASSUMED: none (XIAO-class boards mount by the
edge pads); board\_init must not add default M3 holes on a board this small.
\item Height: no limit stated.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{6. Quantity \& budget}
\begin{itemize}
\item Quantity: 5 assembled boards (prototype run). ASSUMED (open question 4).
\item Unit cost: no target stated. Posture: JLC economy PCBA, Basic/Preferred
parts where they exist, Extended only where the function needs it (module,
sensor, charger, connectors).
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{7. Assembly}
\begin{itemize}
\item JLC economy PCBA, single-sided SMD (top). ASSUMED.
\item The JST-PH battery connector, USB-C and JST-SH are SMD variants so they ride
the PCBA run. Edge pads ship bare (no header).
\item 2 layers, 1.6 mm FR-4 (open question 7 on thickness), HASL lead-free, green.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{8. Compliance/safety flags}
\begin{itemize}
\item Mains voltage: NOT APPLICABLE - USB 5 V input only.
\item Battery: APPLIES. Single-cell lithium-polymer charging. Safety unknowns
(chemistry confirmation, cell capacity, charge current, temperature sensing,
reverse-insertion) are questions 1a-1e below; the unattended run answers them
PROVISIONALLY and conservatively, re-confirmed at H1.
\item Motors: NOT APPLICABLE.
\item \textgreater{}30 V: NOT APPLICABLE (highest voltage 5.25 V VBUS).
\item High current (\textgreater{}3 A): NOT APPLICABLE (\textless{} 0.6 A anywhere).
\item RF transmit: APPLIES - 2.4 GHz WiFi/BLE through a pre-certified module
(ESP32-C3-MINI-1 carries FCC/CE/IC module grants). The board must not
modify the RF path; the module's antenna keep-out is a hard layout rule.
\end{itemize}
\subsubsection*{9. Open questions}
Unattended run: the orchestrator answers these on the owner's behalf (delegated, "decide for yourself") and records each as PROVISIONAL.

1. Battery (safety): 1a. Is the cell a 1S lithium-polymer / Li-ion, 4.20 V full charge? Recommended default: YES, 4.20 V termination. 1b. Cell capacity class? Recommended default: \textasciitilde{}400 mAh (300-1000 mAh cells still safe at the chosen current). 1c. Charge current? Recommended default: \textless{}= 200 mA (0.5C of 400 mAh). 1d. Battery temperature sensing (NTC)? Recommended default: NO NTC fitted; require a protected cell; charger IC with thermal regulation. 1e. Reverse battery insertion protection? Recommended default: no active element; polarity marked on silk (JST-PH pin 1 = +, the Adafruit/ SparkFun convention). 2. Environment indoor 0-40 C, bare board? Recommended default: YES. 3. Qwiic 3.3 V budget for external devices? Recommended default: 100 mA. 4. Quantity 5 assembled? Recommended default: YES. 5. Size: is XIAO-size a soft preference the honest layout may exceed? Recommended default: SOFT. 6. Edge pads: plain plated 0.1 in through-holes rather than castellations? Recommended default: plated through-holes (no castellation fee). 7. Board thickness 1.6 mm? Recommended default: 1.6 mm (JLC default stackup).

\subsection*{Review waivers}
\subsection*{P4 schematic waivers - PCB-0020-A esp32c3-node (2026-10-01)}
ERC: 0 errors, 0 warnings (all 3 sheets). netlist\_audit: pass, 182/182 expected pins. schematic-reviewer (fresh context, sonnet): 0 errors, 6 warnings. Dispositions:

1. VBUS budget \textasciitilde{}650 mA transient vs 500 mA default USB (charger 196 mA + TX peak). Accepted: the same deviation was recorded at P2 (power\_tree.md); average load \textasciitilde{}0.1 A, and the MCP73831 backs off as VBUS sags. Owner sees it at H2. 2. D1 SMF5.0A clamps up to 9.2 V at full pulse current; U2 VDD abs max 7.0 V. Accepted for a USB-powered hobby node: the clamp sits at \textasciitilde{}6.4 V for the small hot-plug transients a USB port produces. A lower-clamp TVS is a candidate revision B item. 3. J2 LiPo has no reverse-polarity protection. Accepted at P2 (no reverse-battery FET); P6 must put a "+" silk mark at J2 pin 1 and the guide must state the pack polarity. 4. U3 Tj \textasciitilde{}114 C worst case. Carried to P6/P7 as a layout duty: GND pour + \textgreater{}= 2 vias (constraints.json thermal entry). 5. Strap pins IO2/IO8 are on the J4 edge pads. Accepted: the 10k pull-ups hold them high, J4 is DNP, and the guide will say not to load them low at reset. 6. TS-1187A pin pairing (1+2, 3+4). Verified on PCB-0015 for the same pulled symbol against the XKB drawing (that board's main\_sheet.py notes); no change. Also noted: parts/ PDFs J2\_SM04B... and J3\_S2B-PH... carry swapped refdes prefixes from P3 naming; the netlist and parts.json are right.

  binding limit on USB: 0.32 W worst sustained -\textgreater{} Tj \textasciitilde{}114 C at 40 C (theta-JA 230.6).\\
- BME280 C92489 7.05 USD, Bosch-only; SHT40 fallback if stock drops.\\
- Straps per module DS: GPIO2/8 10k up, GPIO9 BOOT, EN 10k/1uF; LED GPIO10, VBAT GPIO3.\\
- USB-FS: 90 ohm dropped on 2L, no series R, USBLC6 at the receptacle, VBUS bulk \textless{}= 10 uF.\\
- XIAO: MIT licence covers Seeed's OSHW-XIAO-Series repo (library/docs); the wiki's\\
  C3 schematic/KiCad downloads state no licence. XIAO has no battery sense, external antenna.
\end{quote}
